title: Tour Guide plan digest (payload of the `plan_digest` envelope)
description: The chat-sized view of a built Plan: per day the theme, numbered stops with times and Maps links, legs and warnings; the Later items; the Drive ids of the plan and the brochure. schemas/index.mjs also checks: the whole payload ≤ 60 000 characters, days in date order, stop numbers unique per day, Later slugs unique, leg flags unique, tz a known zone. Contract C10 (TG-PHASE-10) added optional fields: top-level tz, day spare_minutes, stop time_style and check_on_day, leg estimated, distance_m, flags, taxi_minutes and buffer_minutes; a digest without them stays valid. Contract C11 (TG-PHASE-11) added optional fields: top-level part and parts (a digest too large for one envelope arrives in parts sharing one build_id; part ≤ parts, a part after the first sends later: []), day sunset, start, end, bags, dinner and extras, stop last_entry, minutes_source, crowd_slot, facts_line, booking_line, price_line and menu_checked; the 60 000-character cap applies per part. Contract C12 (TG-PHASE-12) added optional fields: top-level country_code; day leave_by and areas; stop visited, local_name, address, payment and close; dinner local_name, address, payment and price_line (WP-12b, for the morning message); leg stations (a TRANSIT leg only, tour-guide-checks.mjs); a leg's from or to may be the reserved slug "here" (a re-plan that started from a shared location).

tz.description: C10: the destination's IANA time zone; the core keeps it on the trip for today/tomorrow and booking times.

country_code.description: C12: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the destination, for the weather lookup.

part.description: C11: this envelope's part number (1-based); with parts, never alone.

parts.description: C11: how many parts the build has; the core stages parts until every one of this build_id has arrived.

spare_minutes.description: C10: unplanned minutes left in the day.

leave_by.description: C12: the departure of the day's first leg.

areas.description: C12: the morning lodging's area, then the night lodging's when it differs (a moving day).

sunset.description: C11: sunset at the night's lodging, in the trip's zone.

start.description: C11: where and when the day really starts (an arrival), only on an overridden day.

end.description: C11: where and when the day really ends (a departure), only on an overridden day.

bags.description: C11: the bag step, one line.

dinner.description: C11: dinner at a real place, with its booking rule.

local_name.description: C12 (WP-12b): the dinner place's name in the local script.

address.description: C12 (WP-12b): the dinner place's own address.

payment.description: C12 (WP-12b): how to pay, from the place's own facts.

price_line.description: C12 (WP-12b): the price and what it includes.

extras.description: C11: nearby evening events and saved places for an early finish.

time_style.description: C10: "about" = flexible times shown as approximate; "exact" = a fixed time (a booking, a tour).

check_on_day.description: C10: one thing to check on the day itself.

last_entry.description: C11: the place's own last entry.

minutes_source.description: C11: where the visit length comes from.

crowd_slot.description: C11: a crowd magnet placed at opening or late.

facts_line.description: C11: researched facts, one line (the app and the brochure).

booking_line.description: C11: the place's booking rule, one line.

price_line.description: C11: the price and what it includes (the app and the brochure).

menu_checked.description: C11: when the menu was last checked against the diet.

visited.description: C12: kept from before a re-plan from the current time.

local_name.description: C12: the name in the local script, from the place's own facts.

address.description: C12: the address as the place publishes it.

payment.description: C12: how to pay, from the place's own facts.

close.description: C12: the place's own closing time that day.

estimated.description: C10: minutes are an estimate, not a routed time.

taxi_minutes.description: C10: the same leg by taxi.

buffer_minutes.description: C10: slack added to this leg.

stations.description: C12: the stations at both ends of a train (TRANSIT) leg, from own access notes only (tour-guide-checks.mjs refuses it on another mode).

rain.description: Rainy-day swaps: indoor places off the plan near an outdoor stop of this day (the DayPlan's rain_swaps).

instead_of.description: The name of the outdoor stop it would replace.

drive_id.description: A Drive file id, or null when that file was not written.
